packMeta.name: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1
packMeta.author: Snooker Practice PWA — P.J. Nolan benchmark adaptation
packMeta.notes: Curated 20-routine benchmark pack adapted from P.J. Nolan senior and junior training programs. Includes benchmark ladders, setup descriptions, coaching purpose, skill tags and transfer tags.
packMeta.description: Curated 20-routine P.J. Nolan benchmark adaptation aligned to the v5.7 routine DB model with setup cards, benchmark ladders, normalized skill maps, target histories, and Club-default/Senior-stretch import targets.
packMeta.recommendedUse: Import selected routines using pack defaults, or override the target/stretch level in the import preview.

routines.name: Nolan #21 / #56 — Line-Up Benchmark
routines.description: Standard line-up. Reds and colours in line-up structure; continue break and count best score. Purpose: Primary break-building, transition precision and positional stability benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Standard line-up. Reds and colours in line-up structure; continue break and count best score.
routines.coachingPurpose: Primary break-building, transition precision and positional stability benchmark.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 35, Club: 75, Senior: 100, Pro: 240. Source: Senior program Practice 21 / Practice 56.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the highest break made during the practice block.
routines.commonMistake: Chasing pots without preserving a playable next-ball angle.

routines.name: Nolan Junior #32 — Five Reds + Blacks
routines.description: Place five reds with five blacks available. Clear the table and attempt to build a compact break. Purpose: Compact high-signal break-building drill for scoring potential without a full line-up.
routines.setupDescription: Place five reds with five blacks available. Clear the table and attempt to build a compact break.
routines.coachingPurpose: Compact high-signal break-building drill for scoring potential without a full line-up.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 20, Club: 32, Senior: 40, Pro: 60. Source: Junior program Practice 32.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the highest break made during the practice block.
routines.commonMistake: Chasing pots without preserving a playable next-ball angle.

routines.name: Nolan Junior #25 — Seven Reds Clearance
routines.description: Place seven reds. Clear the table, replace after each clearance, and count total points. Purpose: Measures controlled continuation and scoring under limited-ball structure.
routines.setupDescription: Place seven reds. Clear the table, replace after each clearance, and count total points.
routines.coachingPurpose: Measures controlled continuation and scoring under limited-ball structure.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 21, Club: 35, Senior: 50, Pro: 80. Source: Junior program Practice 25.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record total points scored under the routine rules.
routines.commonMistake: Chasing pots without preserving a playable next-ball angle.

routines.name: Nolan Technique — Long Red to Black
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Long potting
routines.description: Play long red and finish on black. Count successful red-pot plus usable black position outcomes. Purpose: Long potting with immediate break-building transfer, not isolated potting only.
routines.setupDescription: Play long red and finish on black. Count successful red-pot plus usable black position outcomes.
routines.coachingPurpose: Long potting with immediate break-building transfer, not isolated potting only.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 1, Club: 2, Senior: 4, Pro: 8. Source: Senior technique routine list.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the total score achieved during the routine.
routines.commonMistake: Focusing only on pot success and ignoring cue-ball control after contact.

routines.name: Nolan #42 — 21 Straight Blues
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Long potting
routines.description: Pot 21 straight blues into the corner pockets using screw, stun, follow and stun-through variations. Purpose: Pure cue-delivery and straight-pot consistency benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Pot 21 straight blues into the corner pockets using screw, stun, follow and stun-through variations.
routines.coachingPurpose: Pure cue-delivery and straight-pot consistency benchmark.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 29, Club: 38, Senior: 48, Pro: 86. Source: Senior program Practice 42.
routines.scoringRuleText: Count successful outcomes out of 21 attempts.
routines.commonMistake: Focusing only on pot success and ignoring cue-ball control after contact.

routines.name: Nolan #9 — Long Yellow / Green Series
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Long potting
routines.description: Pot yellow and green from multiple long-distance positions. Count successful pots. Purpose: Long-range precision under angle and distance variation.
routines.setupDescription: Pot yellow and green from multiple long-distance positions. Count successful pots.
routines.coachingPurpose: Long-range precision under angle and distance variation.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 1, Club: 2, Senior: 4, Pro: 6. Source: Senior program Practice 9.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the total score achieved during the routine.
routines.commonMistake: Focusing only on pot success and ignoring cue-ball control after contact.

routines.name: Nolan #13 — Pink / Black Control
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Cue-ball control
routines.description: Pot pink and black repeatedly, replacing balls on spots. Count total controlled pots. Purpose: High-value cue-ball precision and black-area control benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Pot pink and black repeatedly, replacing balls on spots. Count total controlled pots.
routines.coachingPurpose: High-value cue-ball precision and black-area control benchmark.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 5, Club: 10, Senior: 15, Pro: 30. Source: Senior program Practice 13.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the total score achieved during the routine.
routines.commonMistake: Completing the attempt without checking whether the next-shot outcome is usable.

routines.name: Nolan Cue Ball — Black on Spot Benchmark
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Cue-ball control
routines.description: Pot black from the spot repeatedly, replacing after each pot. Count total successful pots. Purpose: Measures repeatable cue delivery and potting stability around the black spot.
routines.setupDescription: Pot black from the spot repeatedly, replacing after each pot. Count total successful pots.
routines.coachingPurpose: Measures repeatable cue delivery and potting stability around the black spot.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 10, Club: 18, Senior: 25, Pro: 50. Source: Senior cue-ball routine list.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the total score achieved during the routine.
routines.commonMistake: Completing the attempt without checking whether the next-shot outcome is usable.

routines.name: Nolan Junior #5–12 — Blue to Black Transition
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Cue-ball control
routines.description: Pot blue with stun/screw/follow variation and control cue ball to pot black into nominated pocket. Purpose: Transition-control benchmark linking one colour to the next scoring opportunity.
routines.setupDescription: Pot blue with stun/screw/follow variation and control cue ball to pot black into nominated pocket.
routines.coachingPurpose: Transition-control benchmark linking one colour to the next scoring opportunity.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 25, Club: 45, Senior: 65, Pro: 85. Source: Junior program Practices 5–12.
routines.scoringRuleText: Count successful outcomes out of 10 attempts.
routines.commonMistake: Focusing only on pot success and ignoring cue-ball control after contact.

routines.name: Nolan Junior #17–24 — Black to Yellow Recovery
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Cue-ball control
routines.description: Pot black with stun/screw/follow variation and recover position on yellow or nominated next ball. Purpose: Recovery-line and cue-ball control benchmark after high-value colour potting.
routines.setupDescription: Pot black with stun/screw/follow variation and recover position on yellow or nominated next ball.
routines.coachingPurpose: Recovery-line and cue-ball control benchmark after high-value colour potting.

routines.scoringRuleText: Count successful outcomes out of 10 attempts.

routines.name: Nolan #16 / #40 — Rest Clearance Drill
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Rest play
routines.description: Pot reds/colours using the rest and complete the required clearance. Count successful clearances. Purpose: Rest technique under scoring pressure; useful hidden-bottleneck detector.
routines.setupDescription: Pot reds/colours using the rest and complete the required clearance. Count successful clearances.
routines.coachingPurpose: Rest technique under scoring pressure; useful hidden-bottleneck detector.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 1, Club: 2, Senior: 4, Pro: 8. Source: Senior program Practice 16 / Practice 40.
routines.scoringRuleText: Record the total score achieved during the routine.
routines.commonMistake: Changing cue action under the rest instead of keeping a smooth straight delivery.

routines.name: Nolan #39 — Rest Green Clearance
routines.folder: Nolan Benchmark Pack v1 / Rest play
routines.description: Pot green using the rest and clear the table. Count successful clearances. Purpose: Fine rest control plus clearance continuation under awkward cueing conditions.
routines.setupDescription: Pot green using the rest and clear the table. Count successful clearances.
routines.coachingPurpose: Fine rest control plus clearance continuation under awkward cueing conditions.

routines.commonMistake: Changing cue action under the rest instead of keeping a smooth straight delivery.

routines.name: Nolan #24 / #44 — Hit and Hide Benchmark
routines.description: Hit the pack/reds and control the white to finish in the winning safety zone. Count consecutive wins. Purpose: Primary tactical safety and leave-quality benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Hit the pack/reds and control the white to finish in the winning safety zone. Count consecutive wins.
routines.coachingPurpose: Primary tactical safety and leave-quality benchmark.

routines.name: Nolan #10 / #29 — Snooker Escape Series
routines.description: Escape from snooker using one- or two-cushion routes and hit the nominated object ball or pack. Purpose: Escape accuracy, route judgment, and tactical survival benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Escape from snooker using one- or two-cushion routes and hit the nominated object ball or pack.
routines.coachingPurpose: Escape accuracy, route judgment, and tactical survival benchmark.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 25, Club: 45, Senior: 65, Pro: 90. Source: Senior program Practice 10 / Practice 29.
routines.scoringRuleText: Count successful outcomes out of 10 attempts.
routines.commonMistake: Only hitting the object ball without controlling the leave.

routines.name: Nolan #53 — Break-Off Accuracy
routines.description: Practice break-off. Hit the reds and land the cue ball in the target coloured area. Purpose: Opening-shot tactical control benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Practice break-off. Hit the reds and land the cue ball in the target coloured area.
routines.coachingPurpose: Opening-shot tactical control benchmark.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 20, Club: 45, Senior: 70, Pro: 90. Source: Senior program Practice 53.
routines.scoringRuleText: Count successful outcomes out of 10 attempts.
routines.commonMistake: Over-hitting the cue ball and losing the intended safety zone.

routines.name: Nolan Tactical — 29 Behind on Yellow
routines.description: Start 29 behind on yellow with colours remaining. Play scenario and count wins. Purpose: Pressure clearance and match-state decision benchmark.
routines.setupDescription: Start 29 behind on yellow with colours remaining. Play scenario and count wins.
routines.coachingPurpose: Pressure clearance and match-state decision benchmark.
routines.benchmarkNotes: Benchmarks — Junior: 20, Club: 40, Senior: 60, Pro: 80. Source: Senior tactical routine list.
routines.scoringRuleText: Count successful outcomes out of 7 attempts.
routines.commonMistake: Playing the clearance as isolated pots instead of managing frame pressure.

routines.description: Play best-of-seven scenarios with one red left, red on back cushion and white in baulk. Purpose: Frame-ball composure and late-frame tactical conversion benchmark.
